species.real: The wreck of the Rhone stood in for the sunken ship in the 1977 film The Deep.
species.name: Rhonewraith

dex.text: Clanks about the wreck in the dead of the hurricane season, an iron ghost with a nasty case of the creaks. Divers wave. It does not wave back.
dex.fact: The RMS Rhone, a Royal Mail steam packet, sank off Salt Island in the hurricane of October 1867 and is now one of the best-known wreck dives in the Caribbean.
